title: Velaris Enterprise Inference
text:
Velaris Enterprise Inference

next_step:
Finalize SLA language, legal redlines due 2025-03-10

blockers:
legal SLA redlines
PCI-residency confirmation
clarify maintenance window impact

timeline:
2025-01-10 - Created: inbound from partner intro (sales-eng intro)
2025-01-17 - Discovery call (Jordan + Maya) - strong emphasis on throughput & uptime
2025-01-30 - Infra workshop w/ Velaris cloud ops (requirements: on-prem + VPC)
2025-02-06 - Perf POC kickoff (3-model sweep, 2x p99/rt configs)
2025-02-20 - POC results delivered: baseline sustained throughput 42 rps, p95 latency 360ms (64-token responses)
2025-02-24 - Pricing request & reserved GPU template shared (drive://velaris/price-proposal-v1)
2025-02-26 - Security questionnaire submitted (drive://velaris/sec-q-vel-ans.pdf)
2025-03-01 - Legal sent initial SLA redlines (attached in gmail thread)
2025-03-02 - Call with CTO (Ravi + Jordan) to discuss uptime/credits and maintenance cadence

sla_requirements:
Uptime target: 99.95% monthly (Velaris requested) with credit schedule for degradations
Credit schedule proposed by Velaris: 99.9% - 99.95% => 5% monthly credit; 99.0% - 99.9% => 25% credit; <99.0% => 50% credit + termination right after 3 consecutive months below 99%
Throughput guarantees: baseline sustained 40 rps per model at 512-token contexts; burst to 120 rps for up to 10 minutes; throughput SLA tied to reserved GPU pool size
Latency SLOs: p95 end-to-end response <= 400ms for 64-token responses (chat use-case); p99 degradation allowances defined in appendix
Maintenance windows: planned maintenance <= 2 hours per event, max 4 hours per month, scheduled in low-traffic window (00:00-04:00 local), 72-hour advance notice required; emergency maintenance allowed with 1-hour notice for critical security fixes with defined mitigation credit
Support & response times: P1 (system down/high-impact) initial response 15 minutes, engineering follow-up hourly, resolution target 4 hours; P2 (severe degradation) initial 1 hour, target resolution 8 hours; P3 (non-urgent) initial 4 hours, target 3 business days
Operational transparency: weekly token-level latency/cost dashboards, 24x7 paging for P1, named TAM and quarterly business reviews included
Data residency & audit: audit logs retention 12 months by default, option for extended retention; KMS integration for key rotation; SOC2 evidence to be provided before go-live

reserved_gpu_plan:
Requested reservation: 8x H100-equivalent (or 16x A100-80GB equiv) with 25% headroom for short bursts
Autoscale/burst policy: allow automatic burst to 12x for up to 2 hours/day for scheduled events, with SLA-adjusted pricing for burst hours
Capacity planning note: current POC performance maps to 8 GPUs for baseline 42 rps; Velaris wants margin for 50% growth over 12 months
Failover & fallback: automated routing to secondary region (VPC-peered) in event of full capacity loss; fallback model variant (smaller quantized model) for degraded mode

notes:
AE notes (Jordan): Velaris very risk-averse re: downtime - 'cannot have >2 outages/month' verbatim from CTO call
CTO asked for clause: 30-day termination right if platform misses SLA for two consecutive months; legal flagged by Redwood as negotiable
Security asked about on-prem appliance for air-gapped inference - Velaris leaning to VPC + customer-managed HSM instead
Pricing sensitivity: prefer 12-month committed contract with quarterly true-ups; asked for committed discount in exchange for 12-month ARR floor
POC takeaway: model tuning + optimized batching from Redwood Optimize reduced token cost by ~18% on sample workloads
Reference artifacts: drive://velaris/velaris-sla-redlines-20250301.pdf, gmail://thread/CAJ8k3b-velaris-sla, ff://meeting/20250220-velaris-poc (fireflies)

other_requests:
Velaris asked for a fallback policy that preserves session KV cache across model variants (they run conversation continuity in product)
Request for explicit maintenance blackout windows during month-end reporting (two 3-hour blackouts per month), influence on SLA credits under discussion
Legal redline: cap on credits to 6 months of fees - currently being negotiated
